# My App flatpak

Packages My App as a flatpak (`com.example.MyApp`) with
[emb](https://github.com/toyota-connected/emb_cli). `my-app.emb.yaml` names the
embedder, the app, the Flutter SDK and the flatpak runtime, so a build needs nothing
but this directory.

## Build

`flatpak` and `flatpak-builder` must be installed, with the runtime the
manifest names:

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists --user flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user -y flathub org.freedesktop.Platform//25.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk//25.08
```

Then:

```sh
emb cross my-app.emb.yaml --target rpi5-trixie --build --flatpak
```

`rpi5-trixie` is a cross target, so the runtime has to be the one for the
board's architecture, not this machine's: name it in the install, e.g.
`org.freedesktop.Platform/aarch64/25.08` and
`org.freedesktop.Sdk/aarch64/25.08`. `--target local` builds for
this machine with the runtime above.

The first build clones the embedder and the app and installs the Flutter SDK into
`workspace/`; later builds reuse them. The bundle is written to
`workspace/.config/flutter_workspace/cross-build-*/dist/`.

## Install and run

```sh
flatpak install --user workspace/.config/flutter_workspace/cross-build-*/dist/com.example.MyApp_stable_*.flatpak
flatpak run com.example.MyApp
```

## Before publishing

- `icon.png` is a placeholder. Replace it with a 256×256 PNG of your own.
- `metainfo.xml` has no license. `project_license` is a `TODO` on purpose: a
  wrong license is worse than a missing one, and flathub will not accept the
  placeholder.
- `rev:` values in `my-app.emb.yaml` are the commits that were current when
  this repo was generated. Update them deliberately; the comment beside each
  names the branch it came from.
